text:
nora: quick bug report — JS sample app hitting JSON.parse errors when token rotates mid-SSE. Short repro attached.

sam: hosted or private? which SDK version?

nora: hosted (staging). JS SDK v2.4.5, using EventSource polyfill. If token rotation happens ~30s into a long stream, fragments for the same message can interleave and break parsing.

lina: do you have a minimal frame trace? usually it's two sockets overlapping.

nora: trimmed trace: data: {"id":"m1","part":"hello wo"
 data: {"id":"m1","part":"rld"}
 data: {"id":"m2","part":"next"}
 but with rotate we sometimes see m1-part, m2-full, then m1-part which concatenates and breaks parse.

sam: sounds like old socket not fully closed before new opens. Polyfill forwards events from both.

lina: short-term fix: SDK should wait for old EventSource close before opening new one on token refresh. Longer-term: server should send per-fragment metadata (frag_seq, frag_done) so clients can reorder reliably.

nora: I added a wait-for-close guard in sample app and it removed my local repro, but some staging users still hit it. Likely polyfill/network timing differences.

arch-bot: infra: created INFRA-511 to add frag_seq + keep resume-token semantics across reconnects.

lina: also add SDK buffering: buffer partial fragments keyed by message id and only JSON.parse when frag_done or after a small reassembly timeout (configurable per SDK). Add tests that inject 0-500ms overlap and out-of-order frames.

qa-bot: test plan: add e2e harness that simulates token rotate with overlap param, run nightly against staging. Will also sample parse error telemetry.

sam: add telemetry event on parse_error that includes resume-token, polyfill version, and socket ids so we can triage.

nora: filed devex#820 (js-sdk close-guard), infra#511 (frag_seq), e2e#301 (auth-overlap-harness). I'll attach the minimal Node repro and link PRs. Thanks! :thumbsup:
